name: GitHub
summary: Read and work on issues, pull requests and code in your repositories.
description: Lets her read and work on issues, pull requests and code in your GitHub repositories, with a token you make. Every change asks you first.
about: GitHub's official tool server, run in Docker from the image GitHub publishes, pinned by its digest (version 0.20.1).
Make a fine-grained token on GitHub (Settings → Developer settings) with only the repositories and permissions you want her to have. It goes into Sara's vault and is never shown again.

mcp.name: github

secrets.label: GitHub token
secrets.tip: A fine-grained personal access token from GitHub → Settings → Developer settings. Give it only the repositories and permissions she needs.

guide: Install Docker Desktop (or Docker on Linux) and start it.
Make a fine-grained token on GitHub.
Add this tool server with the token, then press Test.
